newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde dated December 6.

-- Privatisation Committee rejects Prime Minister Alain Juppe's plans to privatise electronics and defence group Thomson by selling it to Lagardere. The deal would have included sale of Thomson Multimedia unit to Korea's Daewoo . Committee favoured a competing bid by Alcatel as closer to the state's interest.
-- Investigators favour hypothesis that Islamic extremist groups may be responsible for Tuesday's bomb blast in Paris.

-- Pilots and airline staff unions may cancel a strike planned for December 10 and 11 on news that the air transport sector as a whole could benefit from a new special status cutting labour charges and taxes.
-- Rhone-Poulenc postpones acquiring majority stake in agro-chemical group CFPI, after buying a 28.4 percent stake in November.
-- Unions call for a strike in the oil industry sector for December 10.
